query: Please implement an online shop builder website for creating an online sex shop. The website should have multi-language support (German, English, and Spanish) and be able to connect with payment and supplier systems. Users should be able to browse and purchase products, view product descriptions and photos, manage orders and account information. The website should also have search engine optimization (SEO) and secure socket layer (SSL) functionality. Use floral white as the default background and dark red for component styling.
